# How do weeks, visits, and REDCap instruments relate to each other in the feasibility study?

The feasibility study for ON LiMiT is divided into three sections, or phases,
with a pre-phase section for screening and initial consent. The study is
conducted over a period of 52 weeks, with a number of study site visits and
dietician-led group sessions. The table below shows the relationship between the
weeks, visits, and instruments used in the feasibility study.

## Phases of the study

In this section we will describe the different phases of the study and how they
relate solely to the REDCap collected data. There are a number of other data
collection points that are not captured in REDCap, such as scans, blood tests,
diet compliance, and exercise data. These are not captured in REDCap and will be
described in a separate section.

### Pre-phase: The screening phase

This is the weeks leading up to active participation in the study. This comprise
of week -5 up to and including week 0 and this is where study site visits 1 to 4
takes place where the bulk of the demographic data is captured alongside a
number of questionnaires and other relevant data.

### Phase 1: The weight loss phase

This is the first 12 weeks from 1-12 where study site visits 5 and 6 fall. In
this phase the participants have two large visit days as well as five sessions
with dieticians. The challenge with the feasibility data is that the dieticians
have decided to group their meetings based on the phases, whereas the study site
visits are individual events with a clear naming based on the visit number.

There is a mismatch between the name of the instruments for the dietician-led
group sessions and the instrument names. The name the dieticians see on screen
is referencing weeks 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, and 18. The instrument names
in REDCap are referencing weeks 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, and 18.

The date field from the first dietician-led group session is used to determine
the start of the study for the individual participants. This can in turn be used
to determine the week number for all the instruments that do not have a week
number associated with them.

### Phase 2: The re-introduction of food phase

This phase is weeks 13-18 where normal food is slowly re-introduced. There are
two study visits (7 in week 16 and 8 in week 18), and five dietician-led group
sessions.

### Phase 3: The maintenance phase

This is weeks 19-52 for feasibility. There are two weeks where the participants
HbA1c is measured (weeks 30 and 42) and two study site visits (9 in week 51 and
10 in week 52). There are also four individual sessions with the dieticians. At
the end of the study (in week 52) the participants will have a final study site
visit where the same questionnaires and data are captured as in the pre-phase.

## Table of REDCap instruments that are not tied to a specific week or visit

In this section is shown the REDCap instruments that are not tied to a specific
week or visit. The table is divided into two columns: Instrument and
Description. The Instrument column shows the name of the instrument used in
REDCap, and the Description column shows a brief description of the instrument
as well as stating which weeks it may occur in, as well as which date fields it
contains. These can then be used to calculate the week number later.

  | Instrument                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
  | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
  | stamdata                    | Running updates throughout weeks 1-52. This form will contain basic information about the participant as well as information about drop-out or completion of study                                                                                                  |
  | adverse_events              | Anytime throughout weeks 1-52. This form will register any adverse event the participant experience throughout the study, the form has a date of completion and the dates of the event.                                                                             |
  | fase_1_ditetiske_afvigelser | Anytime through weeks 1-11. This form will register any deviation from the NUPO diet, the form has a date of completion and the dates of the event.                                                                                                                 |
  | fase_2_ditetiske_afvigelser | Anytime through weeks 12-18. This form will register any deviation from the reintroduction of normal meals, the form has a date of completion and the dates of the event.                                                                                           |
  | fase_3_ditetiske_afvigelser | Anytime after week 18. This form will register any deviation from the recommended diet, the form has a date of completion and the dates of the event.                                                                                                               |
  | trningsafvigelser           | Anytime after week 18. This form will register any deviation from the recommended exercise, the form has a date of completion and the dates of the event.                                                                                                           |
  | ekstra_kontakt              | Anytime throughout weeks 1-52. This form will capture any contact between study staff and the participant that falls outside the standard touch points. The form as a date for the contact and it is expected that the form is completed on the day of the contact. |
  | hba1c_follow_up             | Anytime throughout weeks 1-52. This form will register any extra HbA1c testing done at the lab if the study team suspects that there is a problem, the form as a date for the testing                                                                               |
  | medicine_changes            | Anytime throughout weeks 1-52. This form will register any changes to medicine during the study, the form has a date for the capture of the information                                                                                                             |
  | individual_ditistsamtale_1  | At some point between weeks 18 and 50                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
  | individual_ditistsamtale_2  | At some point between weeks 18 and 50                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
  | individual_ditistsamtale_3  | At some point between weeks 18 and 50                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
  | individual_ditistsamtale_4  | At some point between weeks 18 and 50                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
